title: Covalent Tolerance Induction to Factor VIII-Prediction of Inhibitors in Hemophilia
brief_summary: To correlate the Human Leukocyte Antigen type and genetic defect with hemophilia A.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Severe Hemophilia A with an inhibitor level of 0.6 B.U. or higher

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe Hemophilia A with a negative inhibitor
study_population: Subjects with Severe Hemophilia A and a positive inhibitor
